summary: The baby (BabyCare: needs and who holds it; BabyHold: the hold poses on any Actor_B skeleton; BabyModel: the procedural bundle; BabyLink: the node side). All numbers here. Coordinates of a pose are in the CHEST FRAME of the holder: the origin is the spined bone, +x the holder's LEFT, +y up, +z the way the holder faces (the rig's own axes), metres, for a holder cradling on the LEFT arm; a right-arm hold mirrors x. A hand target is given in the BABY's frame (x head, y front, z its left) so the hands always end on the baby whatever the pose. Feeding is a modest caregiving hold: the baby at the chest under a shawl.

nursing.summary: Nursing costs the mother food (through her core: stomach, then reserve, never below zero): a share of her hourly burn while the child is under wean_days, and a small flat amount per feed.

care.summary: How the mother acts (BabyLink). A tick every `tick_s` real seconds.

hold.summary: Timing and life of the hold (BabyHold). blend_in / blend_out seconds of the whole hold; pose_blend seconds between poses. Sway is in degrees of body roll while walking (per m/s of speed, capped), the step rate in Hz per m/s; rock is the soothing sway.

cradle.summary: The baby in the crook of the near arm, the forearm across the body, the other hand under it.

shoulder.summary: Over the shoulder, the baby upright against the chest, head on the near shoulder: a settled baby, burping.

feed.summary: Seated feeding: the baby held close at the chest in a cradle hold, a shawl over the holder's shoulder and the baby. Nothing shows.

reach.summary: Reaching out with the baby (laying down, taking up, handing over): the baby goes to the world point set with reach_to(); the spine leans to it. The baby lies as in the cradle hold.

model.summary: The bundle. Lengths in metres; the long axis is x (head at +x), the front +y.

cradle.summary: The build piece 'cradle' (Cradle, scripts/building/cradle.gd): where a baby lies to sleep. Baby position on it (piece frame) and the spot a holder stands at.

feed: Hush now, little one. Here, this will settle you.
feed_done: Fed and warm. That's better, isn't it?
change: Let me see to your wrappings, {name}.
A fresh swaddle and you'll be right as rain.
soothe: There now. No need for all that noise.
hand_over: Take {name}, carefully. Your arm under the head.
take_back: I'll take {name}. Poor thing wants feeding, I think.

refuse.far: She is too far away to hand the baby over.
refuse.hands: You need both hands free to hold the baby.
refuse.busy: She is busy with the baby just now.
refuse.held: The baby is already in someone's arms.
